# apple_marketplace_search_detail (Resource)

Sets the catalog URL of an alternative marketplace app, which marketplace search uses to find the apps the marketplace offers. An app has one search detail. Import it by the app's ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_marketplace_search_detail" "catalog" {
  app_id      = data.apple_app.marketplace.id
  catalog_url = "https://example.com/catalog"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the alternative marketplace app.
- `catalog_url` (String) URL of the marketplace's catalog, e.g. `https://example.com/catalog`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the marketplace search detail.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_marketplace_search_detail.catalog
  identity = {
    app_id = "1234567890"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the alternative marketplace app.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_marketplace_search_detail.catalog 1234567890
```
